about: Learned rulings and frequently-needed answers, curated from real questions The Oracle handled imperfectly. Baked into the prompt so every future answer starts smarter. Add entries via chat with the league's AI assistant; the weekly bake ships them.

rulings.a: The 1.13 goes to the previous season's Toilet Bowl (losers bracket) winner, slots between rounds 1 and 2, is fully tradable, and is NOT tracked in Sleeper - the commissioner enters the selection manually. Current holder is in upcomingDraft.compPick.

rulings.q: Which pick did a traded 'R1' become, and who was selected there?
rulings.a: Resolve it - never stop at the round. Slot numbers are on every roster's picks list ('= pick 1.11'); for the player selected, fetch the draft board: /v1/league/{lid}/drafts for the season's draft id (use leagueChain for past seasons), then /v1/draft/{draft_id}/picks.

rulings.q: How do the six-team playoffs work?
rulings.a: Per the Aug 2026 amendment: seeds 1-3 division winners, 4-5 best remaining records, 6 = highest Points For among everyone left regardless of record. Seeds 1-2 get Week 15 byes; Week 15 is 3v6 and 4v5. Week 15 losers take rookie picks 7-8 ordered by regular season record (worse record = pick 7).

rulings.q: Can I cover a taxi claim without the exact required picks?
rulings.a: Each required pick may be covered by an owned pick of the SAME round or a designated HIGHER round (constitution 4.3), each pick usable once. If the current year's picks can't cover it, note that post-draft compensation shifts to the next year's draft and point them to the exec committee for timing.

rulings.q: What changed in the 2026 rookie draft ownership before it started?
rulings.a: Draft-day trades moved several picks: the Immigrants sent 1.11 + 3.07 + a 2027 1st out (James Cook/Rico Dowdle return); the 2.08 changed hands twice the same day. Always trust the picks lists and traded_picks final state over memory of earlier ownership.

rulings.q: What is a franchise's trade strategy / trade history?
rulings.a: Call the trade_history tool - the archive covers every season and it is accurate. Build the narrative ONLY from returned trades. When summarizing a franchise's current core, quote player names from that franchise's own roster block; players from other rosters must never appear in the list.

rulings.q: How many picks does a team hold?
rulings.a: Count the lines in their picks list - state the exact number and enumerate. Never approximate.

rulings.q: Who made a historical trade / whose record is a past season?
rulings.a: Franchises changed hands - attribute every past trade, record, and blunder to the owner AT THE TIME using franchises[].managerHistory (year -> owner handle). If the actor predates the current manager, say "then-owner X" or "the franchise under previous management" - never pin a predecessor's move on today's manager. Known handoffs: swillke (RyDonn 2018-20 - incl trading Josh Allen to Bryan in 2019 - then lucaspdenney 2021-24, Steven since 2025), Risky Business (walt21ryan 2018-20, Cyres since 2021), Dirty Birds (Bodzi 2018-22 - incl the Hurts-for-Russell-Wilson trade - Ben since 2023).

rulings.q: Is Tim's 2027 first round pick protected? What happens if it is the 1.01?
rulings.a: Yes. Risky Business (Cyres) holds Crab Boilers' (Tim's) 2027 first, acquired from Title Chase in the Aug 31, 2026 three-team trade. It is protected against the 1.01: if it lands at 1.01 it swaps for Ben's (Dirty Birds) 2027 first, which Title Chase owns. Two conditions: Risky Business must hold Tim's pick until the 2027 draft order is set, and if Title Chase trades Ben's 2027 first before then, the protection is void. Full detail is in pickConditions.
